scientific_question: Can one of three bounded terrestrial-interface formulations improve within-station monthly TN dynamics beyond the pre-F1 Q72-F00-S0/S1-T1-H1 Parent?
parent: Q72 -> F00 -> S0/S1-12 -> post-GW T1 -> H1_GLOBAL -> independently trained P1/P2
formal_models: S0 and S1-12 crossed with mu={12,36,60,96,144,240} months

L1_SHARED_CATCHMENT_MEMORY_REPLACES_T1.complexity: no fitted candidate parameter; memory mu is the same fixed formal-member value as Parent
L1_SHARED_CATCHMENT_MEMORY_REPLACES_T1.equation_order: F00/S0-or-S1 source release -> combine pre-T1 quick and GW inputs -> one shared memory with rho=mu/(1+mu) -> split released N by current quick/GW input share -> frozen quick lag rho_q=0.25; GW allocation has explicit Qgw>0 release gate; no post-GW T1 remains
L1_SHARED_CATCHMENT_MEMORY_REPLACES_T1.spinup: independent pre-1961 equilibrium for every formal member
L1_SHARED_CATCHMENT_MEMORY_REPLACES_T1.comparison: equal-complexity non-nested location challenge; a convex Parent-to-L1 bridge is used only for known-truth recovery, never in observed fitting

L2_Q72_ANTECEDENT_WETNESS_EFFECTIVE_LOSS.state: lag-1 Q72 gw_response_state_end_mm, standardized by reach and calendar month using hydrology from 1961 through the fold training-end year
L2_Q72_ANTECEDENT_WETNESS_EFFECTIVE_LOSS.survival: exp(-lambda*max(H_wet,0)) applied equally to Parent local quick and GW TN before aquatic routing
L2_Q72_ANTECEDENT_WETNESS_EFFECTIVE_LOSS.direction_lock: lambda is nonnegative; if zero is selected, the candidate closes and may not be replaced post hoc by a signed gain

L3_PATHWAY_MPR_SLOPE_PERMEABILITY.quick_covariate: length-weighted geometric mean Andreadis slope_used by reach
L3_PATHWAY_MPR_SLOPE_PERMEABILITY.normalization: each covariate is standardized over all 230 reaches, so exp(gamma*z) has geometric mean one
L3_PATHWAY_MPR_SLOPE_PERMEABILITY.forbidden: station, tree or reach random delivery parameters

frozen: Q72 as the only water, quick/GW and hydrologic-state source
Andreadis geometry only; reference discharge forbidden
candidate_selection: P1 training data only inside each fold; P2 cannot select a terrestrial structure; ties choose the exact Parent endpoint, then lower complexity/magnitude

formal_gate.primary: P1 station-macro station-demeaned log1p anomaly RMSE
formal_gate.simultaneous_test: studentized Westfall-Young/max-T over the three F2 candidates using the same paired station bootstrap replicate indices
formal_gate.required: at least 10/12 point-improved and simultaneously improved on P1 anomaly; at least 10/12 P1 absolute noninferior; at least 10/12 P2 absolute noninferior; no repeated optimizer, eta, aquatic-vf, candidate-boundary or mass/state confounding

claim_boundary: Passing supports an effective terrestrial-interface operator under current annual-source and river-TN information. It does not identify true fertilizer timing, manure fraction, SON inventory, mineralization constant, groundwater age or source identity.
